extraction.name: FOMO60K
extraction.description: FOMO60K is a large-scale, heterogeneous dataset of 60,529 brain MRI scans from 13,900 sessions and 11,187 subjects, aggregated from 16 publicly available sources. The dataset includes both clinical- and research-grade images, multiple MRI sequences (T1, T2, FLAIR, DWI, and others), and a wide range of anatomical and pathological variability, including scans with large brain anomalies. Minimal preprocessing was applied to preserve original image characteristics.
extraction.creator: Asbjørn Munk, Stefano Cerri, Jakob Ambsdorf, Julia Machnio, Sebastian Nørgaard Llambias, Vardan Nersesjan, Christian Hedeager Krag, Peirong Liu, Pablo Rocamora García, Mostafa Mehdipour Ghazi, Mikael Boesen, Michael Eriksen Benros, Juan Eugenio Iglesias, Mads Nielsen
extraction.citeAs: Munk, A., Cerri, S., Ambsdorf, J., Machnio, J., Llambias, S. N., Nersesjan, V., Krag, C. H., Liu, P., García, P. R., Ghazi, M. M., Boesen, M., Benros, M. E., Iglesias, J. E., & Nielsen, M. (2025). A large-scale heterogeneous 3D magnetic resonance brain imaging dataset for self-supervised learning. arXiv:2506.14432v1 [eess.IV].
extraction.rai:dataCollection: FOMO60K was aggregated from 16 publicly available brain MRI datasets, spanning clinical- and research-grade imaging, multiple MRI sequences, and diverse anatomical and pathological variability.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Brain MRI scans aggregated from 16 publicly available sources: MGH Wild, SOOP, BraTS-GEN, OASIS1, OASIS2, MSD Braintumor, IXI, NIMH, DLBS, IDEAS, ARC, MBSR, UCLA, QTAB, NKI, and AOMIC ID1000.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: MRI preprocessing comprised three main steps: reorienting images to RAS orientation, affine co-registration using mri_coreg from FreeSurfer 7.4.1, and skull-stripping using SynthSeg (FreeSurfer 7.4.1). For DWI scans in 4D format, b=0 volumes were extracted separately and three diffusion-weighted volumes were selected and averaged to produce a single representative 3D image.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: SynthSeg (FreeSurfer 7.4.1) was used for skull-stripping by outputting segmentation masks of brain structures.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset will continue to grow in future releases as additional cohorts and modalities become available.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: FOMO60K is intended to support the development and benchmarking of self-supervised learning methods in medical imaging at scale. The dataset can be used with no further pre-processing for pre-training.

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: MRI preprocessing comprised three main steps: reorienting images to RAS (Right–Anterior–Superior) orientation, affine co-registration, and skull-stripping. All scans were first reoriented to RAS and affinely co-registered using the mri_coreg command from FreeSurfer 7.4.1, with default parameters. Skull-stripping was performed using SynthSeg (FreeSurfer 7.4.1), which outputs segmentation masks of brain structures.
